subject: foxwife-fertility
q: THE SISTER HAS A HUNDRED KITS, A POLICY, AND AN INHERITANCE. SHE STILL HAS NO NAME.
detail:
ANSWERED, AND THE QUESTION’S CENTRAL ASSUMPTION WAS WRONG.

THE ORIGIN: A VERDANT FOREST AROUND WHAT WOULD LATER BE CALLED THE HUBRIS OF HUMANITY — THE TOWER OF BABYLON. FOREST FIRST. The tower came after and took the name. And the home itself HAS LONG SINCE BEEN LOST TO HISTORY.

THE ARCHIVE ASKED WHERE A PLACE WAS THAT COULD STILL BE RETURNED TO AND STILL PERFORM A REMOVAL. THERE WAS NO SUCH PLACE. They travelled to WHERE THEIR PEOPLE ENDED UP LIVING, before those people TRANSPORTED THEMSELVES TO ANOTHER WORLD, and had it done there. A HOMECOMING TO A PEOPLE RATHER THAN TO A PLACE — which also means a window: after the forest was gone, and before the kin left this world. THEY MADE IT INSIDE THAT WINDOW, AND NOBODY HAS SAID BY HOW MUCH.

SO THE FOUR NOUNS THE ARCHIVE OFFERED — a place, a people, a house, a temple — RESOLVE TO THE SECOND ONE, and the first is rubble. The capability was never in the geography. IT WAS IN WHOEVER THEY ARE FROM, and whoever they are from is no longer in this world at all.

WHICH MAKES THE PROCEDURE UNREPEATABLE WITHOUT ANYBODY HAVING SAID SO. The forest is gone, the kin have left, and the Archive is not concluding irreversibility from that — ONLY NOTING THAT NOTHING IN THE RECORD NOW NAMES ANYONE STILL CAPABLE OF IT.
